name: Corin
aliases: the boy / the Dalaran boy (Sylvanas, interior)

physicalDetails.detail: Young and thin. Plain grey coat with a violet cord stitched round the collar; a satchel on a strap across his chest. Ink on every finger of his right hand; the skin under his eyes 'dark as a bruise'. Small upright handwriting (his copies, notices and the Heavy/Clean column are all in it).

Fumbles under pressure: pulls the stool out for Jaina so fast it tips, catches it; hands full of brass tags and keys, 'Not that one... no. Sorry. A moment.'; gets the satchel buckle through on the second try; starts up the street too fast, comes back, falls in at Jaina's pace hugging the satchel to his chest in both arms; walks on her dead side with one hand held a finger's width from her sleeve. Goes pale when he argues against Havel but keeps his hand flat on the bills.

voiceMarkers.detail: Over-formal and over-apologetic, starts sentences and abandons them ('Were you sent? About the shipments?', 'I— it isn't, though.', 'No, I— sorry, Captain, but they will.'), then lands the fact and talks fast once he is on paper. 'Ranger-General' said carefully, 'getting all of it in'; 'Lady Proudmoore'. Calls Havel 'Captain'. Havel calls him 'lad'.
Talks in marks, bills, days and counts: 'Forty-one I'd swear to, since midsummer'; 'Look at the days on them'. Corrects the scale of a claim ('It isn't four yards').

beliefs.belief: The poison is travelling under copied yard marks and the city (and Dalaran) are not looking; nobody above him is coming, so speed matters more than process.
beliefs.trueOrFalse: Borne out on the page: Jaina's reads of the sample room match his copied marks (every bag on a copied mark is bad, true marks clean).

beliefs.belief: Waiting for a proper arrest means arresting five tired men after the crock is washed or in the weir (Kett's bills are written for the first carts out).
beliefs.trueOrFalse: Plausible and supported by Cyndia's and Lyriel's observations (seven loaded carts gone down the lane; crew locked in the rope-walk; more going toward Tenter Row).

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Come with the grab and be on the spot to read Kett's bills for the Ranger-General before the prisoner has time to think; get Jaina's reads and his own paper in front of someone who will act.
goalsAtChapterEnd.underlying: Be answered. A summer of weekly letters to the Citadel inspection desk and then the Archmage's secretary has got no reply.

emotionalStateAtChapterEnd.state: Nervous, sleepless, pale and past caring about the nerves; keyed up to be useful. Bolder than at the gate-post: argues down Havel twice and volunteers to go into the lane.

decisionsThisChapter.detail: At the post: asks Jaina outright if she was sent about the shipments; draws out his copied waybills and Fenner's hook mark (started at the bottom, dark bead at the foot) and the count of forty-one; interrupts Havel's 'it's four yards' to say it is not.
Offers to take Jaina into the sample room with his access tags; goes with Jaina and Lyriel through the inspection offices and writes down her readings at her dictation after her blots.
Argues for speed against Havel's dawn arrest with Kett's bills; tells the room nobody from Dalaran is coming.
Volunteers to come on the raid ('I can tell you what's on their bills when you've got him'); Sylvanas tells him to stay behind Proudmoore.

abilitiesDemonstrated.ability: Paper forensics: spots copied yard marks by stroke order (hook started at the bottom, dark bead where the pen rested); cross-checks Fenner's own book against the bill (both south wagons in the shed with a cracked axle on the day billed).
Cross-references inspection copies, village reeves' letters and bills to find 41 copied marks since midsummer; reads Kett's bills to infer 'first carts out, nothing kept overnight'.
Access: a ring of brass tags (copy room, sample room, others) and a magister's-ring entry to the sample room; knows the kind of hasp lock on Kett's loft door.

howOthersAddressHim.speaker: Havel
howOthersAddressHim.pattern: 'Corin' (to call him over), 'lad' (reproving or kind: 'Not now, lad.', 'Hear me out, lad.').

howOthersAddressHim.speaker: Jaina
howOthersAddressHim.pattern: 'Corin.' flat, first name, no title ('Corin. Who did you write to?').

howOthersAddressHim.speaker: Sylvanas
howOthersAddressHim.pattern: No name aloud ('Take him.', 'Stay behind Proudmoore.'); interior 'the boy' and 'the Dalaran boy'.

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Presses an inky hand flat against the satchel when anxious or hopeful; winds the strap round his fist; finger on the first 'Heavy' then lifts it off. Hugs the satchel to his chest in both arms while walking.

knowledge.detail: Chapter 7: Inspection copies of waybills (second copy of every bill leaving the city under a yard's mark); forty-one copied marks since midsummer across Fenner's, the Exchange and Garside's, on the south, weir and east roads; some villages on copied marks have since written in sick, some not yet. Wrote weekly to the Citadel inspection desk, then the Archmage's secretary; never answered. Inspectors take a sealed marked bag off every flagged load for the sample room; nobody opens them. Kett's bills are all written for the first carts out. He does NOT know who is behind the loaders.

Chapter 7: his notices of flagged shipments (delivered by hand to the gate post) sit unread in a dusty stack under the cracked river stone on Havel's table; Havel tells him 'leave it with the others, lad, and I'll get to it'.

arc.lie: If he keeps writing to the right desk someone above him will answer.
arc.truth: Nobody above him is coming; he has to act with the people who are here.
arc.currentPosition: Chapter 7: earns his place by being right each time he speaks and by moving toward the danger. Not comic relief, though he is nervous and over-prepared.
